body:
## Goal
Implement an alternate attachment-download design from `main`: no preloaded files and no attachment indexer. Add an agent-callable command that downloads only GitHub user-attachment URLs on demand.

## Context
This supersedes the broader pre-download approach in PR #428: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/428

The requested command shape is:

```shell
node .agent/dist/cli/download-github-attachment.js \
  --url "https://github.com/user-attachments/files/..."
```

The command should be attachment-specific, not a general authenticated GitHub downloader. It should accept raw URLs from the agent but only allow `https://github.com/user-attachments/(files|assets)/...` URLs. This avoids scanning all past comments, avoids pre-downloading files before the agent starts, and avoids exposing an authenticated curl-like primitive for arbitrary GitHub URLs.

Current architecture notes:
- `run-agent-task` already passes `INPUT_GITHUB_TOKEN` into the agent step.
- `buildSharedEnv()` mirrors that into `GH_TOKEN` / `GITHUB_TOKEN`.
- The base prompt already documents token handling boundaries.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Add `.agent/src/cli/download-github-attachment.ts` and ensure it builds to `.agent/dist/cli/download-github-attachment.js`.
- The CLI accepts `--url <raw-url>` from the agent.
- The CLI validates only `https://github.com/user-attachments/files/...` and `https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/...`.
- The CLI rejects non-GitHub URLs and non-attachment GitHub URLs.
- The CLI downloads using `INPUT_GITHUB_TOKEN`, `GH_TOKEN`, or an existing repo-supported token env var order, without printing token values.
- The CLI enforces a fetch timeout and max file size, including protection against oversized responses.
- The CLI uses safe filename handling and writes only under `$RUNNER_TEMP/agent-attachments/`.
- The CLI prints the local path and useful metadata such as URL, filename, bytes, content type, and destination path.
- Add shared helper code as appropriate for URL validation, filename sanitization, timeout handling, and size caps.
- Update `.github/prompts/_base.md` to tell agents to use this command for `github.com/user-attachments` links and not raw `curl` or browser fetches for private attachments.
- Update docs for the command.
- Add tests for valid attachment URLs, rejected URLs, missing token, timeout, oversized response, filename handling, and successful download.

---

Requested via issue_comment at https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/428
